tips.text: Run bounties only for the piece in the current pool, and do other content when the pool shows a piece you already own.
Run the 40-60 bounties in a squad, and return to Cetus to reroll when the objective chain is slow (defense, spy, long escort).
Buy all three pieces with Pearls when Dog Days is running; it removes the RNG.
In Dog Days, throw Lob Blob water balloons for kills; a direct hit one-shots, and busy public squads give more kills than solo.
Expect a few hours of ordinary Cetus RNG spread over several pool windows.
